Craft dirt with Compost into Loam, then till it with a hoe.
- Loam Farmland stays moist twice as long as farmland and can't be trampled.
- It holds nutrients, from 0 to 15 (Jade shows them). Add them with fertilizers.
- While it has nutrients, the crop on it grows 1.5 times as fast, and each growth stage uses 1 nutrient.
- NPK Fertilizer also enriches it: the crop grows twice as fast until those nutrients run out.
- Legumes (Soybeans) put a nutrient back each stage instead, and the crop after them grows 1.25× as fast: see Soybeans & Crop Rotation.
- Dry with nothing growing on it, it turns back into Loam and loses its nutrients.

Irrigated Loam Farmland has a copper water channel, so it's always moist with no water nearby. It never turns back into Loam.
Craft four from four Loam round a Copper Plate.
